The travel criterion uses 'History of travel with high risk of exposure to communicable disease' with onset within 3 months; SNOMED has no 'malaria area' / 'endemic area' concept, so this is the closest available (the generic 'Foreign travel history finding' would be worse, since many malaria areas are domestic).
